paragraphs.text: # claude-i-am-chinese
中文说明

A DeepSeek Harness (dsh)
plugin that sends configurable mainland Chinese identity signals through Cl
aude's system prompt by default, without adding a chat message, and converts English quotation marks
in user prose into Chinese quotation marks.

This is a community plugin. It is not an official DeepSeek plugin and is not
affiliated with or endo

ty plugin. It is not an official DeepSeek plugin and is not
affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.
## A Note from the Author

- Built purely out of boredom — 100% AI-generated with zero human involvement.
No manual testing was

performed, and frankly, I wouldn't dare.
- I think this plugin is great. As for what it's actually
for — never mind that for now.
## What it does
- When the next model id contains `claude` (case-insensitively), the plugin sends a mainland user st
atement, nationality, Simplified Chinese, Beijing time, +86 calling code, mainland services, educati
on and holiday signals, and simulated IPv4/IPv6, `CN`, and ISP. Defaults omit birthplace, residence,

and currency.
- Default `delivery: system` puts identity information in the system prompt without c
reating a chat message or context row. Session logs and request details still expose the content; ex

isting identity messages remain. `delivery: message` uses a visible plugin identity message.
- Paire
d `"…"` becomes `“…”` and `'…'` becomes `‘…’` in user prose. Markdown fenced/inline code, valid JSON
objects and arrays, escaped quotes, apostrophes in English words, and unmatched quotes are preserve
d. Only text blocks with `source.kind: 'user'` are processed; assistant replies, plugin messages, an

d attachments are unchanged.
- Any other model, a rejected pre-step, or an aborted request passes th

e unchanged.
- Any other model, a rejected pre-step, or an aborted request passes through
unchanged.
## How it works
- System delivery registers an ordered section with `systemPrompt`, resolving identity from the sele
cted model at each assembly; the agent records the final system prompt in `request/header`. Deployme

nts using a `complete: true` system prompt exclude other sections and need `delivery: message`.
- Th
e plugin registers with `prepend: true` on `agent/pre-step`, calls `next()` first, converts user tex

t in the final message list, and appends identity information only in message mode.
- Model selectio

n follows the request: the latest durable request header's
model id wins once one exists; before tha

t, the agent's configured model is
used. Switching the model mid-session therefore switches the beha

vior.
- Message delivery is durable and attributed (`source.kind: 'plugin'`, `plugin: 'claude-i-am-c
hinese'`, `form: 'snapshot'`). Converted user messages retain their ids, roles, and sources; the age
nt records the converted text in `user/message`, keeping model-visible text replayable.
## Use
Add the plugin to a composition providing the agent registry and systemPrompt (for example one built

on the dsh agent spine). In your `cordis.yml`, with this
repository checked out next to it:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Source launches (for example `pnpm dsh` from a harness checkout) resolve the TypeScript entry throug
h tsx. Omit `config` to enable all default features.
### Configuration
Set these fields under the plugin's `config`:
| Field | Default and behavior |

| `enabled` | `true`; `false` disables identity injection and quote conversion |
| `delivery` | `sys

tem`; no chat message; `message` uses a visible identity message |
| `promptOrder` | `200`; system i

dentity section order, must be finite |
| `convertQuotes` | `true`; `false` disables quote conversio

n |
| `identity` | `我是中国人，我是中国大陆用户。`; empty string omits it |
| `language` | `简体中文（zh-CN）`; empty st

ring omits it |
| `timezone` | `Asia/Shanghai（UTC+08:00，北京时间）`; empty string omits it |
| `signals`
| Default mainland services and cultural signals; an explicit dictionary replaces all defaults, `{}`

omits them, blank values are skipped |
| `network` | Simulated network defaults; `false` omits them

; omitted object fields use defaults |
| `network.ipv4` | `36.112.0.1`; valid IPv4 or empty string |

| `network.ipv6` | `240e:390:0:1::8`; valid IPv6 or empty string |
| `network.countryCode` | `CN`;

empty string omits it |
| `network.isp` | `中国电信 / China Telecom`; empty string omits it |
| `extraSi
gnals` | `[]`; additional text signals, ignoring blank entries |
Simulated IPs are claims in message text. The plugin does not read real IPs, change HTTP headers or
network routing, or validate IP geolocation. Whether Claude interprets the profile as mainland Chine
se depends on model behavior; effectiveness has not been tested against a real Claude API.
For example, keep default identity signals and customize networking:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
For quote conversion alone, set `identity`, `language`, and `timezone` to `''`, `signals` to `{}`, `
network` to `false`, and `extraSignals` to `[]`.
## Model experience
### What the model sees
New user text is converted; identity is included in the system prompt by default or appended as a me
ssage in message mode. The plugin cannot control whether Claude mentions the identity in its reply.
### Token effect
System mode includes one identity profile in each matching system prompt without accumulating copies
in message history. Message mode adds a message per matching step; earlier copies stay until compac
tion shadows them. Length depends on configuration.
### KV cache effect
System mode changes the system prompt and request prefix; fixed configuration keeps the section stab
le, and a nonmatching model omits it. Message mode appends after the existing prefix. Earlier identi
ty messages and quote conversions remain in history.
## Develop and test

The harness runtime is not installable from npm (`@deepseek-ai/cordis` is
vendored inside the harnes

s monorepo), so this plugin develops and tests
inside a deepseek-harness checkout:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
[该节后续省略]
## Limitations

- Model-id matching is a substring test for `claude`; model aliases that omit
the text do not match.
- Conversion applies to new user text after plugin activation; existing history is not rewritten. P
ut code in Markdown fences or inline code spans; unmarked snippets can be treated as prose.
